description_expanded: OverviewHot TubPrivate Beach Access-5 Minute Walk, Free Beach Shuttle, Playground, Heated Community Pool, 2 Bikes `Sandy Sisters`The Space Elegant Coastal Retreat – Relax & Unwind in Style! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Elegant Coastal Décor – Stylish, high-end finishes for a serene retreat Streaming TV – Enjoy your favorite shows & movies anytime Complimentary Shuttle to the Beach – No hassle, just relax & ride Gated Beach Access – Private beach access with restrooms & showers available Community Pool & Kiddie Pool – Perfect for families & sun-seekers Fitness Room – Stay active with on-site gym access Playground for Kids – Family-friendly fun in the perfect coastal setting Designated Covered Parking – Convenient & worry-free parking 2 Beach Bikes- Easily Cruise around 30A Big Redfish Dune Lake - Enjoy beautiful sunsets from the dune lake PierWelcome to Sandy SistersThis stunning second floor condo will have you feeling relaxed and at ease the moment you cross the threshold and take in the beautiful, high-end finishes and elegant coastal décor. Making the most of the phenomenal location, this community is designed to evoke feelings of relaxation by providing every opportunity to enjoy the great outdoors at this unique setting. Guests of this family-friendly rental will also enjoy a shared adult pool, kiddie pool, playground, fitness room, and complimentary shuttle service to the nearby beach without the crowds or the hassle of driving. Enjoy the gated beach restrooms and showers.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival****No Cable. Streaming TV Only**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom - King sized bed, private en suite bathGuest Bedroom - King sized bed, twin over twin bunk bed private en suite bathCommon space - Queen sized sleeper sofa**Keep in mind live music can occasionally be heard from Redfish Village restaurantsAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! .Show less
